normalizer: nfc-whitespace-v1; case, initials, accents, punctuation preserved

definitions.active_population: Union of distinct keys on paired papers within the selected window
definitions.study_population: Union of distinct keys on all paired papers dated 2010-01 through 2025-12
definitions.fractional: One/k credit per byline slot; credits of slots sharing a key accumulate
definitions.coauthored: One full paper per distinct key per paper; repeated raw-name slots counted once
definitions.decile: Rank active keys separately by identity, window and output measure; exact 10% population mass
definitions.ties: Proportional membership across cutoff ties; scores rounded to 12 decimals only for ranking
definitions.study_ranking: Cumulative output over the full observation window, not an average of window deciles
definitions.interpretation: Observed contributor keys in a selected OpenAlex population, not validated people
